rows.text: When he mentioned checking all the buttons and see if they work i bought a Honda from a main dealer in the summer so couldnt actually see if the rear heater screen worked. First time i needed to clear the rear screen, months later, it didnt work fully, some elements were broken and  Honda wouldnt fix them even though the car had a warranty.

Congraaats! 🎉🎉🎉 It is a big step for you, I know. However, it doesn't have my native language (yet) to set as a first language, I'll keep the app waiting for an upgrade that contains Hungarian.🙏🏻  Btw is there any way we (followers) could help at translating? I'd join in gladly😊
